title: Malaysian Satay Cabbage Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and crunchy stir fry featuring Malaysian satay flavors with cabbage and crunchy elements.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add cabbage and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes or until slightly tender.
Add peanuts and fried shallots and stir-fry for another minute.
In a small bowl, mix together satay sauce, soy sauce, and sugar. Pour the sauce over the cabbage mixture and stir-fry for another minute.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Transfer to a serving platter and serve immediately.
